title: lichen-node rpl_stack test rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet fails: InvalidSourceRoute
description: Discovered on heft once project-LICHEN-worker6-qhh6 unblocked lichen-node compilation (first run of the suite on this box; surfaced while verifying t8ox). cargo test -p lichen-node: 293 passed, 1 failed - thread panicked at rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:443:91: called Result::unwrap() on an Err value: InvalidSourceRoute (test rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet). Not caused by t8ox/p4mf changes (announce_store.rs only, merged commits 9e8cae59b5/3aa7b4245c/64bdfc03bc never touch rpl_stack). Likely related to the in-flight RH3 router-validation work (project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix / hahk describe Rust-side RH3 admission and route validation; my branch merged beads-worker-4/6/7 at 12:14-12:22). rpl_stack/receive.rs and util.rs also carry pre-existing cargo-fmt drift, suggesting uncommitted/divergent state in this area. Note for claimer: cross-check against worker6-xyix's fix direction (router-level SRH validation: final != outer dst when SL!=0, single RH3, aligned address grid) and the C reference behavior (routing/router.c) before changing admission logic; also confirm the test's expected route grid matches the vectors in test/vectors/.
close_reason: Already fixed by project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix, commit 6008e4eed8 on beads-worker-7. Root cause: the test's own packet was malformed per the C router (routing/router.c parse_ipv6_dispatch rejects Next Header 59 No-Next followed by 8 trailing payload bytes with -EBADMSG) - the committed survey_routing_headers rejection was CORRECT behavior, the test packet was the bug. Fix changed the test to a valid datagram: next_header 17 (UDP) with a minimal RFC 768 header (ports 0, length 8, zero checksum) at rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:414-441, plus the matching SRH next-header byte assertion [17,4,3,2,0,0,0,0]. Verified on heft: cargo test -p lichen-node 294 lib tests green incl. rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet (run against a local oscore patch carrying begin_unprotect_observe_response; the heft mirror /home/mark/crates/oscore v0.1.1 14c9327 still lacks the observe API - Mac push from worker6-2hn1/qhh6 remains the real unblock). Also note: this bead's discovery 4ipc (no Rust test asserts survey rejection paths) is satisfied by the same commit's srh_admission_vectors_match_c_router_policy consuming 34 C-parity admission vectors (test/vectors/srh_admission.json).
